topics.label: Lecture introduction
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the topic of complement and frames expectations for the session.

topics.label: Fundamentals and central role of C3 in complement
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics establish the foundational concepts, naming conventions, and pivotal biochemical role of C3 in the complement system.

topics.label: Pathways of complement activation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the three upstream pathways that initiate complement activation and converge on C3 convertase formation.

topics.label: Effector mechanisms of activated complement
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the downstream immunological actions carried out by activated complement to neutralise pathogens and stimulate inflammation.

topics.label: Regulation of complement and host protection
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains the regulatory proteins and inhibitory mechanisms that protect host tissues from inadvertent complement destruction.

topics.label: Clinical consequences of complement deficiencies
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details the clinical presentations and disease phenotypes associated with deficiencies across different complement pathway components.

topics.label: Pathogen evasion of complement
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic examines the molecular strategies evolved by microbial pathogens to circumvent complement-mediated clearance.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the complement lecture and previews the next lecture on the adaptive immune system.
